scope: Exact local reviewed response catalog, three original starter object senses. Not open-ended writing accuracy, general proficiency, CEFR or efficacy.
sourceRights: Original project-authored starter object metadata; canonical assets unchanged. New prompt/response fixtures authored in this implementation.
admission: F01 exact saved crosswalk and sense/hash plus live approved/published verified lexical content; target book, pencil or bottle with starter-object-v1 revision1 only.

calibration.method: Separate explicit input/expected dimension fixtures reviewed against prompt and noun sense. No inferred statistical generalization from exact lookup agreement.
calibration.normalization: Outer whitespace, case and one final period only; missing initial capital/final period receives form1 on otherwise recognized responses. Negation, added clauses and instructions are not removed.
calibration.meaning: 2: specified object meaning demonstrated; 0: reviewed different sense or literal incompatibility with the specified object. Unknown interpretation is uncertain, never 0 by default.
calibration.use: 2: requested activity demonstrated; 0: reviewed sentence does not demonstrate that activity. Meaning can remain2 when use0.
calibration.form: 2: reviewed sentence pattern with ordinary initial capital/final period; 1: specific article/agreement/capital/punctuation repair. No averaged grade.

examples.reason: Noun object, reading activity and complete grammatical sentence.
Alternate subject and correct third-person agreement.

examples.response: She read a book every day.
examples.reason: Valid habitual past tense; do not assume present.
Singular count noun lacks a determiner.
Object meaning is clear, but no reading activity is expressed.
Grammatical verb booking, not the requested noun object.
Grammatical scheduling verb, not a demonstrated writing-tool noun.
Grammatical packaging verb, not drinking from a container noun.
May mean reading its label; insufficient basis for a confident semantic penalty.
Unusual action does not by itself prove a different lexical meaning; no automatic penalty.

compatibility: WrittenRubricResult revision1 decoder replays exact policy and rejects modified scores/spans/provenance. Preserve revision1 implementation when introducing later policies. F05 must not apply written capitalization/punctuation to ASR transcripts.

designFixtureMapping.RUBRIC-VALID: Two or more reviewed alternate answers per admitted original target; hypothetical editorial borrow remains outside admitted content.
designFixtureMapping.RUBRIC-UNCERTAIN: Ambiguous/unreviewed valid responses receive no numeric dimensions; editorial effect is not falsely admitted.
designFixtureMapping.RESEARCH-OFF: Supplemental table only; zero canonical attempts/SRS/reward/research/outbox effects.
